notes.title: New CAVYHOUSE Title - The Little Tomb Steam Page Now Live!
notes.content:
[b]"Is there a dead body who'd like to be buried in me?"[/b]

CAVYHOUSE, the developer of Forget Me Not: My Organic Garden and The Sealed Ampoule, is working on a brand new title—The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search for a Dead Body!

The Steam page for the game is now live, so please wishlist it and look forward to more updates!
